doc.title: John Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 18, 2023 [interview 2 of 2]

chapter: Original songs and the record business
title: Name That Tune game
summary: Rowe plays two-bar tunes for Pizzarelli to name: 'C Jam Blues', 'Chicken a la Swing' and 'DaVinci's Eyes'.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I’m going to play a little name that tune with you. Are you ready?
All right. I’m going to start out with something easy. You just get two bars. [scats]
Okay. So you can move on to the next round here but you only get two bars in this one because that’s all I had time to write out.
“Let’s Dance?” No. No. Oh that’s “Chicken a la Swing.”

Yes. Very good. Okay you get one more but I’m going to give you some clues because I don’t know how well I can vocalize this one. First of all, key of G, 3/4 time, imagine accordion, clarinet and cello in the background. All right? [scats]
[scats] that’s the part of the tune.
Yeah I’m not sure I got that right, okay. That’s a hint.
